reviews.title: Text no longer working, no support

The text messages on both numbers do not work anymore. I tried to reach out to support, and no response. So now I have two numbers paid for until July next year, and I can’t even text. Back to the drawing board, now I have to find ANOTHER phone app, pay upfront, and hopefully find one that keeps working this time.
